search_keyword.description: The keyword to search for in exploit databases like PacketStorm, ZeroDay, etc.

output_format.description: The file format to write search results to. Supported values: 'txt' or 'html'.

download_exploits.description: Whether to download exploit files found during the search. Corresponds to the --get flag.

auto_upgrade.description: Whether to upgrade pompem to the latest version before searching. Corresponds to the --update flag.
